name: Reunion India Real Estate
tagline: Source-backed India real-estate regulatory search and verification
description: A free, read-only remote MCP server for searching and verifying official India real-estate regulatory references with source provenance. Current tools cover RERA circulars and notices, official portal and process references, QPR/project-bank material, and reviewed stamp-duty and registration-charge references.

install.notes: No authentication is required. The server is read-only and returns source provenance for indexed official references.
